name: eval
description: Swarmail's eval recipe, interim path (decision 0119, recording the operator's 2026-10-18 rulings on #148): one exec trial seat that runs the opaque eval-trial driver (swarmail-evals trial, which starts Swarmail and the fixture as its own children and runs the real brokkr driver claude|codex|dsh as a child so the journal keeps tokens, turns and tool rows), then one exec scoring gate, which is the recipe's protected review (the engine requires a review phase in every bundle, brokkr 0.12.0 layer 1): it re-applies the task's check to the app's retained state and never reads the agent's account. Nothing in the trial seat is confined: every result is recorded as unconfined. No retries: a retried trial is a different experiment. Until the F1/F2/F5 follow-up lands, the recipe runs the oracle and null controls only and paid agents wait; it moves to the MCP broker when brokkr#766 lands.
